text: The app doesn't do justice to the excellent service by Amex. It's just too finicky (for lack of a better word). It's confusing is you have multiple cards. An overview of all the cards which doesn't fade or animate out of view will be appreciated.

It's such a good experience speaking to Amex India customer care each time. It's like a breath of fresh air. I have about 7 different credit cards and nothing beats the customer service experience of Amex. To be frank, there are issues with Amex acceptance across many establishments but Amex's rewards program and customer service is what makes them stand out.

The old app was better. I don't understand why they had to remove the spend monitor to be eligible for the annual fee waiver. Now, I have to chat with an executive each time to know how much my total spending is. Though the card itself is great, the application is terrible. Excellent app for Amex credit card users. An app which delivers more than expectations. Truly innovative, easy to use and with all information available (Statement, Reward point credit and prompt customer service). I must say, I am in awe of such development. App developers at Amex are really the best. No any app and I repeat, no any app has impressed me this much in last 1 year. And, Amex services are, truly premium. The only card, for which annual fee makes sense, because Amex delivers more than that.
